arcs.title: The Six Remaining Ducks of Elspeth Holt
arcs.summary: Day 4: Duck the eighth has arrived — a heathered tam-o'-shanter with a rowan sprig — delivered by Mrs. Holt in person. The note read 'Not the detective. The other one.' Lucy relocated immediately; the household remains uncertain. Steve's hat log now includes a 'Intended Recipient (Disputed)' column. Mrs. Holt had tea, admired the shelf, and left. Four ducks remain. Day 5 (resolution): Mrs. Holt should arrive with the final duck — or the final ducks — and the scene should be the quiet, full-circle moment the arc has been building toward. The 'detective' question (the deerstalker) and 'not the detective, the other one' (the tam) should be resolved — almost certainly landing on Lucy and Jersey respectively, or reversed to comic effect. The completion should feel like a small ceremony: all eleven ducks on the Jeep, all hatted, Mrs. Holt satisfied, nothing more to do but stand there and look at it. Warm, final, and without fuss.
